name: WFW Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Created at WFW's own first supercard, Summernight Powerslam, and won by Inferno out of a twelve-man battle royal and a count-out final over co-winner Lenny Rose.

name: WFW World Championship
epitaph: Changed hands at WFW's own first supercard, Summernight Powerslam, when the Ultimate Fighting Machine pinned champion Johnny "the rebel" Banger.
